messages.subject: Sentinel - exposure if prosecuted (privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Ahead of the Board, our advice note on likely sentencing exposure is attached, with Counsel. We are aiming for medium culpability / harm category 2, which on the Company's turnover gives a starting point of GBP 540,000. With full mitigation we target GBP 400,000 before plea credit, ~GBP 266,000 after an early plea, plus HSE costs of about GBP 18,400. If the HSE establishes high culpability the numbers roughly double, which is why agreeing the basis matters. This is privileged - please keep it to the Board.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
